definitions.gloss: route of infection; mode of transmission
definitions.explanation: The pathway by which a pathogen spreads from one host to another. A key concept in public health and epidemiology, frequently discussed in news reports about disease outbreaks.

examples.japanese: {感染経路|かんせんけいろ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦まだ→まだ：00603_mada⟧⟦{特定|とくてい}→特定：04275_tokutei⟧⟦されていない→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The route of infection has not yet been identified.

examples.japanese: ⟦{主|おも}な→主な：21018_omona⟧{感染経路|かんせんけいろ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{飛沫感染|ひまつかんせん}→飛沫感染：24192_himatsukansen⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{接触感染|せっしょくかんせん}→接触感染：25168_sesshokukansen⟧⟦である→である：09855_dearu⟧。
examples.english: The main routes of infection are droplet transmission and contact transmission.

examples.japanese: {感染経路|かんせんけいろ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{遮断|しゃだん}→遮断：15673_shadan⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦{手洗|てあら}い→手洗い：12761_tearai⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦マスク→マスク：05075_masuku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{着用|ちゃくよう}→着用：13693_chakuyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{推奨|すいしょう}→推奨：12907_suishou⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Handwashing and wearing masks are recommended to block the routes of infection.

notes:
USAGE:
Became widely known to the general public during the COVID-19 pandemic. Frequently appears in news, government announcements, and health advisories.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {感染経路|かんせんけいろ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{特定|とくてい}する→特定する：19642_tokuteisuru⟧ (to identify the route of infection)
- {感染経路|かんせんけいろ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{遮断|しゃだん}→遮断：15673_shadan⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to block the transmission route)
- {感染経路|かんせんけいろ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{不明|ふめい}→不明：11352_fumei⟧ (route of infection unknown)

TYPES OF TRANSMISSION:
- ⟦{飛沫感染|ひまつかんせん}→飛沫感染：24192_himatsukansen⟧: droplet transmission
- ⟦{空気感染|くうきかんせん}→空気感染：25169_kuukikansen⟧: airborne transmission
- ⟦{接触感染|せっしょくかんせん}→接触感染：25168_sesshokukansen⟧: contact transmission
- {経口感染|けいこうかんせん}: oral transmission
